 Early Voting In Falmouth Tops 2022 Election 
 By LIN LIN HUTCHINSON 
 Nov 6, 2026 
 1 hr ago 
 0

 Falmouth has exceeded its 2022 early-voting participation rate and outpaced the statewide rate ahead of the 2026 state election.
 Approximately 34% of Falmouth’s registered voters participated in early voting this year, surpassing the statewide rate of approximately 21%. The town’s participation rate also topped its 2022 total, when about 31.9% of registered voters cast ballots before election day.
 This year, 3,297 Falmouth residents voted early in person, compared with 1,563 in 2022. In-person early voting accounted for approximately 11% of the town’s registered voters this year, compared with 6% four years ago.
 As of October 31, a total of 6,519 Falmouth residents had returned mail-in ballots, compared with 7,107 in 2022. However, 2,123 outstanding mail-in ballots had yet to be returned to the town clerk’s office.
 Mail-in voting accounted for approximately 22% of registered voters this year. In 2022, approximately 26.1% of the final total voters returned their ballots by mail.
 Falmouth has 29,062 registered voters for the 2026 state election, compared with 27,212 in 2022.
 All nine polling locations will open at 7 AM and close at 8 PM on Election Day. The town clerk’s office does not expect initial results to be available before 9 PM at the earliest.
 Falmouth’s nine precincts will vote at the following locations:
 Precinct 1 voters will cast their ballots at Town Hall, 59 Town Hall Square.
 Precinct 2 voters will vote at the Falmouth Community Veterans Center, 300 Dillingham Avenue.
 Precincts 3 and 6 will vote at the Falmouth High School gymnasium, 874 Gifford Street.
 Precinct 4 voters will cast their ballots at the St. Anthony’s lodge building, 167 East Falmouth Highway.
 Precinct 5 residents will vote at St. Elizabeth Seton Church hall, 481 Quaker Road.
 Precinct 7 voters will cast their ballots at Waquoit Congregational Church hall, 15 Parsons Lane.
 Precinct 8 residents will vote at the Navigator Club, 55 Ashumet Road.
 Precinct 9 voters will cast their ballots at the Jewish Congregation Community Center, 7 Hatchville Road.
